---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement to Intent Kit
title: "feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Describe the developer workflow or traceability problem that is not currently solved.

## Proposed outcome

State the outcome and how a user would know the proposal succeeds. Avoid prescribing implementation details unless they are necessary for compatibility.

## Proposed approach

Describe the smallest useful change, including any effect on graph nodes, relations, evidence, generated Markdown, or CLI commands.

## Alternatives considered

Describe reasonable alternatives or existing workarounds.

## Proof expectation

Explain how the feature should be tested or what evidence would demonstrate it works.
